'''JT-03''' was one of many [[Droid/Legends|droids]] owned by [[Jordel Tlan]], who kept him company during his retirement on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and were the only beings he could trust. Tlan's worker [[Netula Pahn]] was in charge of maintaining the droids and mentioned that JT-03's [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were malfunctioning.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
JT-03 is mentioned briefly in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="SWTOR" />
